name: opencode-froggy
install: OpenCode resolves this plugin from the npm registry automatically when the config entry is present. Offline fallback: unpack deps/opencode-froggy-1.3.0.tgz into the OpenCode plugin cache (~/.cache/opencode/npm/opencode-froggy@latest/<hash>/node_modules/).
notes: The 4 bundled skills are delivered by the plugin itself (not by ~/.agents/skills). A fresh install advertises 869 repo skills + 4 plugin skills = 873 skill IDs.
